table_name: Table 7C - Requirements for Firefighting Installations - For Institutional Buildings

bands.condition: Height above 15 m, OR height <=15 m with area >= 501 sqm
Not exceeding 45 m height, area 501-1000 sqm
Not exceeding 45 m height, area 1001 sqm and above

bands.note: Refer to hydraulic-calculation note / Annex D provisions.

bands.condition: Not exceeding 45 m height, area 501-1000 sqm
Not exceeding 45 m height, area 1001 sqm and above

notes: Basement areas or storage of oxygen/medical gases/gas fuel/laundry/linen-waste/transformer-HT rooms within the building footprint or basement must be sprinklered and comply with CL-3.
If the building has EV parks in podium/basement, must be sprinklered and comply with CL-5.
If building height exceeds 60 m, hydraulic calculations with multi-level pumping/storage and gravity-redundant down-comer; pumps should not exceed 12 bar shutoff pressure.
Supplementary protection for specific hazard/critical rooms per Table 9/10/11 as applicable.
Pump pressure/quantity must be supported by hydraulic calculations.
Rate-of-rise heat detection in EV parking/charging areas; smoke detectors in basements except ICE parks (CO sensors, recommendation only for parking/podium).

3785/2500 lpm at 10 bar common pumping with 350000/255000 litre storage for a cluster of up to 5 buildings up to 45 m height (not closer than 9 m); CL-5 required if closer than 9 m or shared EV basement.
Multi-level pumping/storage per SLD for cluster buildings over 45 m; water storage at every 45 m above per building.
If cluster exceeds 5 buildings, another equivalent pump/storage set required (max 2 sets recommended).
If building height exceeds 30 m, must comply with hydraulic-calculation-based system architecture.
